place.name: Mondulkiri province
place.description: Mondulkiri (Khmer: មណ្ឌលគិរី, Mǒndǒl Kĭri [mɔndɔl.kiriː]; lit. 'circular mountains') is a province (khaet) of Cambodia. Bordering the provinces of Kratié to the west, Stung Treng to the northwest, Ratanakiri to the north, and the country of Vietnam to the east and south.
